_how: Newest first. Add a new release at the top of 'releases', or add items to today's. tag: New, Improved or Fixed. area: Break guides, Spot Builder or Site. Then run python3 build/breaks/hub.py, which writes breaks/release-notes.html.

releases.title: More Run Good Life break guides
items: RGL #6134 Gilded Collection PYT #2: a pick your team MLB break with live open and sold teams. The Dodgers go to one buyer by random draw.
RGL #6135 Oops All Animation: a random letter break with Marvel and Disney cards. Three of its seven boxes are listed so far; the page says which ones are missing.
RGL #6136 Pass the Turkey NFL: a random team break with seven boxes, five of them listed here, plus how the $1,000 turkey prize gets passed around.
RGL #6137 Pro Debut Half Case: a random letter break with four boxes of 2026 Topps Pro Debut Baseball, every prospect listed by first letter.
RGL #6135 Oops All Animation now lists five of its seven boxes: 2025 Topps Finest X-Men '97 and Pixar Gold were added, and number names like Pixar's 22 have their own # spot.
Checklists and pack odds for 2025 Topps Finest X-Men '97 and 2025 Topps Pixar Gold.
RGL Chrome in the Club PYL #2: a second pick your letter WWE break by first name, with live open and sold spots. Same letters and prices as #6128, with one Chrome box instead of two.
RGL #6138 Gilded & Cosmic: a random team MLB break. Four of its six boxes are listed; 2026 Pristine and 2026 Chrome Black checklists aren't in yet.
RGL #6139 Joy of Five Star #2: a random team NBA break with the same five boxes as #6131.
RGL #6128, #6129 and #6130 have run. Their guides stay up under Past breaks, without the live open and sold status.
Tonight's Run Good Life pages show RGL's YouTube stream right on the page, in place of the title card. After the stream ends, the same player shows the replay.
Live chat from the breaker's YouTube stream: tap Open live chat under the video on open breaks and it pops up in a small window in the corner, so the spots stay in view. Sign in to YouTube to post.
The "? by real name" tag is gone from the spot lists; it cluttered the cards.

releases.title: Run Good Life break guides
items: Run Good Life (RGL) break guides are here. RGL #6128 Chrome in the Club PYL: a pick your letter WWE break by first name, with live open and sold spots. Garbage Pail Kids cards are filed under the wrestler, as RGL's rules say. The 2026 Topps National Convention box is included; the 2025 Topps Finest WWE box isn't in the guide yet.

RGL #6129 Gilded Collection PYT: pick your team Major League Baseball (MLB) across Chrome, Update, Gilded, Museum and Finest, with live open and sold teams. The Dodgers go to one buyer by random draw.
RGL #6130 Chrome & Midnight PYT: pick your team NFL with Topps Chrome and Midnight, with live open and sold teams. The Raiders go to one buyer by random draw.

Run Good Life #6131 Joy of Five Star (NBA), #6132 Absolute Finish the Case (NFL) and #6133 Immaculate NASCAR guides. RGL sets its team pairings and letter groups live, so these pages list every team or letter on its own.
Four more official racing checklists in the library: 2025 Panini Prizm Racing, Select Racing, National Treasures Racing and Turn Four Racing. RGL #6133's guide now includes its Prizm Racing box.
2025 Topps Finest WWE is in the library, from the official Topps checklist with its pack odds. RGL #6128's guide now includes its Finest box, so all six of its boxes are covered.

Multi-sport boxes now show only the featured sport's cards. RGL #6128 lists just the 50 wrestlers from the National Convention box instead of every football, basketball, baseball, soccer and Star Wars card. Also fixed: Ricky Saints was listed as "Ricky" in that checklist.
Each break on the Break guides page, and the top of each break's own page, now shows the breaker's title card image, so it's easy to spot the one you're in.
GB1040 Multi Product Madness (Acme Packs): every name in the five boxes, sorted into the 21 letter spots Acme posted. Runs Tuesday, November 24 at 9:00 pm Eastern.
Panini Absolute breaks now tag every Kaboom card and list the Kabooms by spot, so you can see which teams or letters could land one.
The key above each spot's card list now explains every tag that spot uses, including HIT (only on hit cards like autographs, relics, inserts or numbered parallels), NIL and Kaboom.

College players whose school shares an NFL nickname no longer land on that NFL team. Drew Mestemaker (Oklahoma State Cowboys) was showing up under the Dallas Cowboys; he and the other Oklahoma State, Boston College Eagles and Pittsburgh Panthers players now count as college (NIL) players in Panini Absolute, Obsidian and Donruss Football.

Pull checklist: check off the cards you pull from a spot's page, the By box view (tap a name) or the By name view (tap the colored box square). A My pulls panel lists everything you checked in the break, and you can email the list to yourself or copy it.
Past breaks page: every break that has already run, newest first, with search plus breaker and month filters. Linked at the bottom of every page next to Release notes, and from the Break guides page.
Added 2025-26 Topps Midnight Basketball from the official Topps checklist (100 base, 191 autographs, 80 inserts) with Topps' pack odds, so player values reflect how rare each hit is.

Added 2026 Topps Royalty Collection WWE from the official Topps checklist: 100 base, 229 single-signer autographs across 30 autograph sets, 92 relic subjects and 70 dual, triple and four-person cards, with women flagged for Men and Women splits.
Added 2026 Topps T205 Baseball from the official Topps checklist: 300 base, 113 on-card autographs, and the T80 Rookie, Cy Young, Backward Hat, City Connection and No Cap cards.

Baseball cards listed under "A's" now count for the Athletics, and old team names (Cleveland, Washington Senators, St. Louis Browns) go to the Guardians, Twins and Orioles instead of the college group.

Added 2026 Topps MLS Black and White from the official Topps checklist and odds: 80 base, 67 autograph signers, and the Global Impact, Developmental, Golden Hour and Flashpoint inserts, with club names so team splits work.
2026 Topps Gilded Collection Baseball now uses Topps' pack odds, so player values reflect how rare each autograph and insert set is.

releases.title: JWJ break night wrap-up
items: JWJ #0246 Cosmic Exalted Logo Club and JWJ #0248 Chromed Up Galaxy ran on Monday, November 23, so their pages are now closed. The guides stay up for looking back at who was in each spot.
JWJ #0244 Balling on a Budget with Flagship NBA has run, so its page is closed and it's off the Break guides page and the Breaks menu. The guide stays up for anyone looking back at their team.

The Breaks menu is shorter: All break guides, Spot builder, a link back to the Main Event Card Vault shop and the Iron Ledger workout program. Each break is listed on the Break guides page, and the release notes are linked at the bottom of it.
Every page now has a Release notes link at the bottom, including the shop.
Iron Ledger, the workout program, now has the same Breaks menu at the top as the rest of the site, so it's one tap back to the shop, the break guides or the Spot Builder.

Live sold tracking now reads spot names that include a price or a note, like "Arizona Cardinals $295" or "A (Women) - $130", the way Run Good Life lists them. Run Good Life pages get their own header color.

releases.title: Live sold tracking, breaker colors and giveaway teams
items: CC875 Immaculate NASCAR (Random Letter) from Colfax, with every driver from the official 2026 Panini Select Racing and Immaculate Collection Racing checklists filed under its letter spot, including the two-letter spots like CA-CH and JI-JY. The break already ran on November 22, so the page is there for looking back at who was in each spot.

Live open and sold status. Pick-your-team and pick-your-letter pages check the breaker's store when you open them and about once a minute after that, so sold spots and prices stay current on their own. A line under the title shows the count, like "25 open, 7 sold." Running now on GB1037 and JWJ #0246.

A break watcher checks Acme Packs, JWJ, Colfax and Run Good Life every 15 minutes for new breaks, and a scheduled task builds a guide page for each new one, turns on live sold tracking for pick-your-spot breaks, and closes pages once a break is gone.

Breaker colors. Each break page has a clean white background, with the breaker's brand in the header and accents: Acme Packs green and gold, JWJ brown, cream and rust, and Colfax black, purple and red. Open spots stay green and sold spots stay red on every page.

Leave teams out, for giveaway teams like a free Dodgers or Raiders spot. In a team break, tap a team to take it off the spot list and out of the pricing; the box cost spreads over the spots you're actually selling. The results, copied list, spreadsheet download and store embed all show a "Left out" line so buyers know.

A step-by-step walkthrough on the How it works tab. It follows a real pick-your-team break from adding boxes to sharing the spot list, with a note on what each section's settings mean. The builder's intro links to it for first-timers.
JWJ #0244 Balling on a Budget with Flagship NBA is back on the Break guides page and in the Breaks menu. It didn't run on November 16 and is running this week instead.
Three Acme Packs guides: GB1037 Midnight Chrome Pick Your Team, GB1038 Midnight Chrome Inception and GB1038 Full Case Absolute Football.
Pick-your-team breaks show each team's price and whether it's open or sold, with a "Still open" tab.

College players in the Absolute break carry an NIL (name, image and likeness) tag. A college player who's already on an NFL roster goes to his NFL team, following Acme's rules; the rest go to the spot holding the first letter of their first name.
This release notes page, linked from the Breaks menu.
Long team names like Buccaneers and Commanders no longer run under the "+ Mine" button. The button now sits in the bottom corner of each spot.
Titles match the breakers' new numbering: the Midnight Chrome Inception break is now GB1039 (Acme), and Chromed Up Galaxy is JWJ #0248.

releases.title: More checklists, my spots and box-by-box lists
items: The Break guides page and the Breaks menu list only current breaks. Finished breaks stay online, so old links still work.

Ten more official checklists from the boxes in Run Good Life's breaks, including 2026 Topps Update Series Baseball, Five Star Baseball, Pristine and Joy of Basketball, Neon and Mint Marvel, Stadium Club Chrome UEFA (Union of European Football Associations), five Panini racing sets in a new NASCAR group, and 2025 Kakawow Aura Marvel. The library is now 193 checklists and about 50,000 names.
Finished breaks get a "This break ran on..." note, and the buying tools switch off. Colfax CC871, CC872 and CC874 were closed after they ran.
Show a box. Pick any box in a break to see every name in it, A to Z, with the spot each one goes to. You can search it and filter to open spots or your own.
My spots. Mark as many spots as yours as you like, then show only those.
Superstar boost, on Strong by default, so star players pull away and team prices stop bunching up in the middle.
Less text on the builder itself. The explanations moved behind "?" buttons and onto the How it works tab.
Paul Heyman spot for WWE breaks: pull him into his own spot and set how sexy he is, from "A little sexy" to "Paul Heyman Guy approved."
Embed in your store: a ready-made HTML table of spots and prices, or a hosted, searchable spot list you can drop onto a product page.

releases.title: Spot Builder launch
items: The Spot Builder and checklist library. Pick checklists and box counts, set a spot count, and it balances letters or teams into evenly weighted spots.
Pricing from your costs: box prices, other costs, fees and profit turn into a price for every spot. You can set any spot's price by hand and the rest rebalance to keep the total.
Team breaks: best balance, one team per spot, or by division. College players can have their own spot, be split by letter or be left out.
Player value: players in more autograph and insert sets, and in rarer ones by Topps pack odds or Panini and Leaf print runs, count for more.
Box types like Hobby, Jumbo and Breaker's Delight, each with its own odds and price, and you can mix two types of the same product.
Search boxes by product, year or sport, and find which spot any name lands in.
The library grew to 97 Topps 2026 checklists, Panini and Donruss lists, and 49 Leaf 2026 releases.
How it works: a short version, section-by-section guides linked from each part of the builder, and an illustrated scoring guide.
Guides rebuilt from the official Topps checklists, adding LogoFractor, Sapphire and Star Wars autographs and Exalted relics, and fixing how Stadium Club Inked cards are counted.

releases.title: Break guides launch
items: Break guide pages: tap a spot to see who you could pull from each box. First up: Colfax CC874 Monster Multi, CC871 and CC872, and JWJ #0244, #0246 and #0247.
A Breaks menu on the storefront and on every break page, plus a Break guides page that lists them all.
